narrative.overview: Auditstream's visual language prioritizes calm editorial restraint, generous whitespace, and zero visual friction. Every page — homepage, documentation, search modal, and error view — lives in a single cohesive Light-Only surface system built on warm gallery off-white (`#fafaf8`), pure white elevated frames (`#ffffff`), delicate warm stone hairlines (`#e6e6df` / `#d4d4ca`), and crisp slate ink (`#0f172a`).
keyCharacteristics: 100% Light-Only system across homepage, docs, search dialog, and 404 page with zero theme flash and single-theme Light Shiki syntax highlighting.
Subtle architectural corner radii (6px controls, 10px code and reference frames, 12px focal cards, 999px small status pills).
Strict semantic color isolation: Editorial Cobalt (#1d4ed8), Committed Emerald (#047857), and Diff Vermilion (#b91c1c).
Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans paired with IBM Plex Mono (tabular-nums, ligatures disabled) at comfortable Retina reading sizes (>= 12px everywhere).
One single spacious focal micro-motion (AuditPulseVisual) driven by a calm 7.8s JS data-phase state machine with smooth transitions and two-leg SVG packets.

rules.name: The Light-Only Cohesion Rule
rules.body: Every route, code block, modal, and visual uses the same Warm Architectural Paper palette. Never introduce dark sections, inverted theme bands, or dual-theme CSS overhead.

rules.name: The Channel Isolation Rule
rules.body: Editorial Cobalt is for identity and navigation; Committed Emerald is for verified persistence; Diff Vermilion is for removals and error markers.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own authority. Never place uppercase eyebrows, kickers, or section-number prefixes above headings.

rules.name: The 12px Legibility Floor
rules.body: No visible text, badge, code label, or diagram annotation drops below 0.75rem (12px).

dos: Do keep the entire site 100% Light-Only on the Warm Architectural Paper palette.
Do verify every foreground/background combination passes WCAG 2.1 AA (>= 4.5:1), including syntax tokens and tinted diff rows.
Do reserve --shadow-focal strictly for AuditPulseVisual and SearchModal, keeping all other frames flat with 1px hairlines.
Do use full 1px borders on rounded elements and keep every font size >= 12px (0.75rem).
Do use IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums and font-variant-ligatures: none strictly for code, SQL, CLI commands, and benchmark figures.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark mode CSS, theme toggles, dual-theme Shiki variables, or inverted dark sections.
Don't place kickers, eyebrows, or section numbers above headings.
Don't use one-sided accent bars on rounded boxes, corner registration brackets, sticky curtain footers, or decorative video files.
Don't fabricate customer logos, testimonials, or unmeasured performance claims.
